---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "GitHub Copilot"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards_sf <- mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 46, 55), between(long, 7, 25)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "lightgray") +
  geom_sf(data = mallards_sf, aes(color = duck_id), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
